## Design

### 2026-11-02: Monday Oct 26th.

**8h**

Monday Oct 26th.
I started by building a prototype out of LEGO to test the basic design, then moved on to using Onshape to plan the servo layout and work out how the robot's parts would fit together. (I know my Idea reel was posted on Thursday but I promise I have been working on it all week).
